## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-04-28  
  **Link:** [OpenAI models, Codex, and Managed Agents come to AWS](https://openai.com/index/openai-on-aws)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI says GPT models, Codex, and Managed Agents are now available in AWS environments.  
  **Why it matters:** This weakens single-cloud dependency and gives enterprises another route to deploy OpenAI tooling inside existing AWS security, procurement, and data-control workflows.

## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

- **Date:** 2026-04-28  
  **Link:** [Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-Pro on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.5-Pro)  
  **Summary:** Xiaomi released MiMo-V2.5-Pro, an MIT-licensed 1.02T-parameter MoE model with 42B active parameters and up to 1M-token context. A companion MiMo-V2.5 model is described as omnimodal across text, image, video, and audio.  
  **Why it matters:** Long-context open-weight models are moving into agentic coding and long-horizon task territory previously dominated by closed systems.

- **Date:** 2026-04-27  
  **Link:** [OpenAI releases Symphony, an open-source Codex orchestration spec](https://openai.com/index/open-source-codex-orchestration-symphony/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI published Symphony, a reference spec and implementation pattern for turning issue trackers into control planes for continuously running Codex agents.  
  **Why it matters:** The operational layer around coding agents is becoming standardized: ticket queues, review loops, and landed PR metrics matter as much as model capability.
